summary: Extensions add typed provenance, retrieval evaluation, safe compaction, and a protected tier for data that should not live in Git.

items.text: Represent each record as a typed event with actor, timestamp, source links, confidence, sensitivity, validity interval, supersedes links, and review state; derive human-friendly indexes from those fields.
Add retrieval regression tests containing answerable, contradicted, expired, ambiguous, and not-found queries, and measure both recall and stale-fact leakage.
Periodically create signed consolidation snapshots while retaining links to source events; expire snapshots on any successor event rather than silently editing history.
Keep secrets, personal data, and erasure-sensitive records in an access-controlled store and commit only opaque identifiers plus non-sensitive provenance to Git.
